item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Tales about SCP-871 are always amusing and surprisingly dark, and this article is no exception. +1

But a few things...
uwu

That's awful convenient.

I think this should be "That's awfully convenient."

And regarding the whole "Keter Cakes" thing, I think it's perfectly fine for the Foundation to call them that, especially employees that are familiar with them. I've always had the headcanon that the Foundation gives SCPs nicknames, and Keter Cakes definitely fits that. "Yeah, I'm on Keter Cake duty."

anyways yes this is a very good article uwu

item.content:encoded:
Since when did we start calling them "Keter Cakes"? It would make more sense to just call them "The Cakes". Everyone would know what they're talking about.

It just feels out of touch for the Foundation to just call them Keter Cakes.
